artworks.title: An Old Nayas Indian, His Granddaughter, and a Boy
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Two Young Hyda Men
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows two standing male figures in a full body view. One man stands with his back to the viewer, holding a paddle, while the other stands in profile with one leg bent and resting on a small rock, also holding a paddle. Both men have long, dark hair adorned with feathers and facial features include high cheekbones and strong noses. They appear focused on something in the distance. Each figure wears minimal clothing, consisting of loincloths. The scene includes other figures in the mid-ground seated in a canoe upon a body of water. The background consists of a soft, scenic depiction of foliage with trees and a misty horizon.

artworks.title: Three Young Chinook Men
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts three men seated on the ground. The man on the left is seated on a log with one leg over the other, holding a bow and a shield. He has long dark hair adorned with red and white feathers. The central figure is seated on the ground, holding a feathered fan and arrows, with a similar headdress made of red and white feathers. On the right, the third man sits on a rock, leaning slightly forward, holding a stick with both hands. His headband incorporates red and white feathers, and he wears beads around his neck. All men are minimally clothed, wearing what appears to be traditional attire. The background shows a simple landscape with hints of greenery, suggesting grass and distant trees under a subtle, lightened sky. The overall setting appears natural and serene, composed mostly of earthy tones.

artworks.title: Klahoquaht Chief, His Wife, and Son
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in the image. The central figure stands upright, facing forward, holding a staff. They have high cheekbones, dark eyes, and straight black hair with feathers. They wear a loincloth and a necklace. To the left, another figure stands in profile, holding a paddle-like object. They have a similar facial structure and wear feathers and a necklace. The figure on the right is seated on a rock, looking forward. They wear multiple necklaces. The background has a pastel gradient and a green border with a label marked '95'.

artworks.title: Klatsop Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals standing in a line on a flat terrain with a soft, neutral background. Starting from the left, there is a male figure with short dark hair holding a spear, another male figure with feathers in his hair holding a paddle or club, a male with a feathered headdress and a red band across his forehead, a female in a skirt with beaded accessories holding arrows, and a small child standing beside her.

artworks.title: Three Walla Walla Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This painting shows three individuals standing side by side. The individual on the left is shirtless, wearing a fur-like loincloth over fringed trousers and holding a long bow and an arrow. The person in the middle is wearing a cream-colored shawl over similar fringed trousers. The individual on the right is also shirtless and wears a fur-like skirt, but doesn’t appear to be wearing trousers. They have a pot or vessel on their head. All three of the people have light brown skin and dark hair. The two people on the left have long feathers adorning their hair and seem to have red markings on their faces. All three of the people have necklaces and earrings. The background shows a grassy plain and a light blue sky. The painting is surrounded by off-white paper and a pale-blue border.

artworks.title: Facsimile of a Sioux Robe
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting of various stick-figure scenes depicting battles, daily life, and rituals on a textured canvas resembling animal hide. The image is organized in several horizontal registers, each portraying different narratives. In the topmost register, figures on horseback are engaged in combat. Below, there are multiple groups of figures interacting in scenes. The lower registers continue with more figures in dynamic poses, possibly illustrating rituals or ceremonies. The central area of the painting has a horizontal bar adorned with feathers or tassels. A small conical shape resembling a lodge or tipi is depicted on the left side of the middle section. The entire piece is surrounded by a greenish-brown border resembling a frame.

artworks.title: A Stone Warrior, His Wife, and a Boy
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in a grassy outdoor area. The person in the center is facing forward, wearing a beige garment with fringe details, a necklace, and a feathered headdress. They hold a decorated object. To the left, a slightly smaller individual stands wearing a similar outfit with necklaces and a red cloth belt. This person also wears a feathered headdress. To the right, another person is shown turned sideways, wrapped in a beige cloth or blanket with long dark hair tied back. Each person wears moccasin-style footwear and colorful striped leggings. The background shows a softly painted sky with hints of clouds and distant greenery.

artworks.title: Copper Chief, His Wife, and Children
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three people standing side by side. In the center is a man wearing a long garment made of animal hide with red accents and a necklace. He has a colorful feathered headdress and holds a shield and a long object. To the right is a woman wearing a red shawl holding a child on her back. The child appears to be resting. On the left is a young boy wearing a tasseled garment and a headpiece with a feather. The background is a clear sky and a plain with some greenery. The scene is framed within an oval border with a rectangle and a green outer frame.

artworks.title: Spokan Chief, Two Warriors, and a Boy
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts four individuals standing in a row. The person on the left is holding a child, the two adults on either side have neutral expressions and are standing confidently, and the central figure holds a staff. Each individual has long, dark hair adorned with feathers, and is dressed in traditional clothing made from natural materials. Some wear beaded necklaces. One person holds a shield, while another carries a quiver of arrows. The background is a neutral gradient, resembling an open space.

artworks.title: Athapasca Chief, His Wife, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing in full length facing the viewer. On the left stands a woman with dark hair, wearing a brown fringed dress with red leggings. The middle figure, likely a man, wears a beaded garment and a headpiece with feathers. He holds a stick or staff. The figure on the right, also likely a man, wears a feathered headdress, a beaded necklace, and an arm band. He is bare-chested with a blue cloth covering his lower body, grey leggings, and holds a painted shield and a ceremonial club. The background features a softly painted horizon within an oval border.

artworks.title: Four Dogrib Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals standing side by side. The first person on the left has long dark hair and a round face. They wear a fringed garment with a draped shawl. The second person also has long hair and wears a headdress with feathers, a fringed tunic, and moccasins. The third individual has long hair with feathers, wears a tunic with geometric patterns, and holds a long stick. The fourth person, a child, stands on the far right, wearing a dress and beaded necklaces, with long hair adorned with beads. The background shows a vast landscape with a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Three Selish Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted standing side by side. The person on the left wears a dark fur garment with feather adornments in their hair. They have a gentle expression and wear white bead necklaces. The central person wears a light fringed garment, holds a red pipe with feathers, and also has feather adornments in their hair. The person on the right wears a light dress with fringe and bead decorations, with long hair adorned with beads. The background shows a painted outdoor setting with soft, natural colors.

artworks.title: Two Chippewyan Warriors and a Woman
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals, depicted from head to toe. On the left, a man stands confidently with his left hand on his hip, wearing traditional attire consisting of fringed leggings, a beaded necklace, and a red band adorned with feathers on his head. In the center, another man stands, wrapped in a white cloak decorated with a sun-like design, with similar pants and hair, and is also adorned with a feathered headband. To the right, a woman stands dressed in a blue dress embellished with detailed beadwork around the neckline and hem. She wears her hair in two long braids and sports multiple beaded necklaces. They stand on a grassy terrain, with a clear blue sky and some clouds in the background. The scene is framed within an oval shape surrounded by a greenish-gray border.

artworks.title: Three Esquimaux
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing side by side on an open, snowy landscape. The person on the left is seen in profile with arms folded, while the two in the center and right are facing forward. The central figure appears to be holding a long, pointed spear and wears a cap with a tassel, a coat, and pants. The person on the right is wrapped in a shawl or large garment and appears to have long hair, carrying a child on their back. The individual on the left has similar attire. All three are dressed warmly. The background shows a gradient sky and a patch of clouds on the horizon. The artwork is framed within an oval matte.

artworks.title: Alaeutian Chief and Two Warriors
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals depicted from head to toe. The central figure stands upright, with the figure on the left seated, and the figure on the right standing in a relaxed pose with a bent leg. Each individual has distinct facial features, black hair adorned with feathers, and dressed in traditional attire including decorative elements made of feathers, animal hide, or fur. The seated individual holds a bow, while the central figure holds a feather-decorated spear. All three individuals wear necklaces and have feathers in their hairstyles. The background features a subtle pastoral landscape of grass and open sky.

artworks.title: Cochimtee Chief, His Wife, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This image shows three people standing in full-body view. The person on the left has long dark hair and wears a headpiece made of natural materials, a blue waist garment, and stands confidently with one hand on their hip. The central figure holds a spear, wears feathers and a cloth wrap on their head, long dark hair, and a red and orange poncho over a tunic and tall boots. The person on the right has long dark hair, wears a turquoise skirt, red leggings, and a decorative necklace, standing with hands by their sides. The background shows a soft landscape with rolling hills and a muted sky, framed in an oval border on a gray and brown rectangular mount.

artworks.title: Mohave Chief, a Warrior, and His Wife
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing in a grassy landscape. On the left, a male wears a feathered headdress, paint on his face, long hair, a fringed outfit, and holds arrows. In the center stands another male wrapped in cloth, wearing a feathered headdress, necklaces, and holding a ceremonial pipe. On the right, a female with braided hair wears a skirt, necklaces, and bracelets. The background consists of green grass and hills under a light blue sky, enclosed in an oval border against a sepia-toned background.

artworks.title: A Yuma Chief, His Daughter, and a Warrior
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals standing against a natural backdrop. The person on the left is a female with long dark hair styled into two braids, wearing a light-colored dress with fringes and beaded necklaces, and is barefoot. The central figure is a male with long hair adorned with feathers, wearing a cloak with a red sunburst design, and jewelry around his neck. The male figure on the right is holding a spear in his right hand and a shield in his left, wearing animal-skin leggings with fringes and a belt, and is barefoot. The background shows green grass, rolling hills, soft blue mountains under a clear sky, framed by an oval border within a rectangular frame.

artworks.title: Three Yumaya Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals standing side by side. The person on the left holds a bow and wears a white garment with accessories. The middle person stands with hands touching in front, wearing a similar garment with orange fringe. The person on the right holds a spear and wears a red-brown cloth with accessories. The background features a natural landscape with soft pastel tones. The scene is framed within an oval border.

artworks.title: Five Maya Indians
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a group of five people, four standing and one seated. They are standing upright and appear to be posing for the portrait. The person on the far left is a male with shoulder-length hair, wearing minimal clothing that covers his waist and hips, adorned with red paint on his body, and has several necklaces. The male next to him has longer hair and wears a wide-brimmed straw hat, a necklace, and holds a bow. The individual beside them is a female with long hair, wearing necklaces, a skirt, and also holds a basket and an arrow. In the background, a seated woman and a standing child can be seen with landscape elements like trees and foliage around them. The seated person wears a wide-brimmed hat and minimal clothing similar to others. The background suggests a natural setting with vegetation and a misty sky. The scene is framed in a circular format within a rectangular mat, bordered by a wide band with catalog numbers above and to the lower left.

artworks.title: Buffalo Chase
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: This is a painting with a central focus on a bison being pursued by a figure on horseback. The scene is set in a grassy prairie under a cloudy sky. The bison is depicted with detailed brown fur and expressive eyes, appearing to move swiftly. A galloping horse is shown next to the bison, with attention to its mane and motion to suggest speed. The composition is enclosed in an oval with a muted border. The style is reminiscent of George Catlin, known for his depictions of Native American life and wildlife.

artworks.title: Buffalo Chase, with Accidents
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The scene is depicted from a slightly elevated point of view, displaying a broad perspective of the landscape. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky filled with blue clouds. In the foreground, a hunter on horseback engages with a group of buffalo. The brushstrokes capture the textures and details realistically. A vast herd of buffalo can be seen extending into the distance across the grassland. The color palette includes earthy tones for the animals and landscape, contrasting with the vibrant sky.

artworks.title: Catlin and Indian Attacking Buffalo
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a vast grassy plain with a herd of bison in the distance. Two figures are hunting near a fallen bison. The sky has subtle bands of clouds and the colors are predominantly earthy tones.
